newsitem.title: LATVIA: NDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION UP 5.2 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: NDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION UP 5.2 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Latvian industrial production grew 0.7 percent in first half of 1997 compared to the same period in 1996, the stats committee said on Wednesday.
The commitee also said in a statement that industrial output was up 5.2 percent in June on a year-on-year basis in comparative prices.
It said in a statement that total industrial production was 114.1 million lats in June in real prices.
Output grew fastest in the water and gas supply sectors, rising by 13.1 percent year-on-year and the processing industry, where output increased 4.7 percent, the statement said.
